title: Systolic blood pressure
text: Sit with back supported, feet flat, arm at heart level; use the correct cuff size and take the reading at rest. Record systolic together with diastolic as one pair.

140 mmHg or above scores watch (ACC/AHA 2017 stage 2 hypertension) and 180 or above, or 90 or below, scores critical. 91 to 100 also scores watch under NEWS2. Tell the crew medical officer about any amber or red result.

citations.source: ACC/AHA 2017 Guideline for High Blood Pressure in Adults: stage 2 hypertension at 140, hypertensive crisis at 180.
NEWS2 (Royal College of Physicians, 2017): single-parameter scores for systolic pressure.
